summary: Microsoft compounds as Azure AI demand converts to revenue at scale; the debate is whether record capex keeps earning cloud-level returns.

pillars.title: Azure demand stays near 40%
pillars.statement: Azure should sustain roughly 38-40% constant-currency growth as AI capacity lands.

pillars.title: Backlog converts, not just grows
pillars.statement: Commercial RPO growth should keep pace with Azure growth, showing multi-year commitments rather than one-off deals.

pillars.title: PC segment is a small drag
pillars.statement: More Personal Computing stays roughly flat and does not dilute group growth.

forecasts.metric: Azure and other cloud services revenue growth

risks.title: Capex outruns monetization
risks.description: AI infrastructure spend grows faster than cloud revenue and compresses returns.

risks.title: Backlog growth decelerates
risks.description: A sharp slowdown in commercial RPO growth would signal demand normalization.
